answer: Every identity must build one shale bridge, and the k-th bridge must face the k-th gale: the first demands 2 spans, the second 6, the third 20, the fourth 70, so the k-th bridge costs the k-th central binomial number of spans. Ten identities pay 250,952 spans, the tenth alone 184,756; each bridge waits one gale season per earlier bridge, so the hundredth fake waits 99 seasons.
